pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with distinct vertices. Edge gradients are mostly smooth with localized sharpening at corner nodes. Flank patches exhibit greater longitudinal elongation compared to lower neck patches.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-toned pathways forming a continuous topological mesh. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pathway thickness is variable, narrowing significantly as it transitions from the neck to the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, stiff-textured mane exhibiting a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the cervical-dorsal transition.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced ventral protrusion located on the lower abdominal midline, characterized by a rounded, focal convexity in the body contour.
